title: Slaanesh Expanded - Vassal Dilemmas
author: Narok-
description:
Summary:

This mod introduces dilemmas that can appear when the player subjugates one of the female Legendary Lords (LL). The player subjugates a LL by making them their vassal or confederating them. There are two versions, one that only activates when playing a Slaanesh faction (Nkari, Azazel, or Sigvald), and one that works with all other factions. All artwork has been created by SOBORO and used with their permission.

Note: This mod is intended to be used with a Slaanesh faction, but by popular demand it will work with any faction. Including the female lords.

Key Features:

Dilemma Chance:

-
Base 35% chance for a dilemma to occur each turn after subjugating your first LL.

-
Each female LL subject increases the base dilemma chance by 5%, representing increased Slaanesh corruption.

-
If a dilemma doesn't trigger, the chance increases each turn until one does, then resets to the normal value.

Dilemma Options:

Slaanesh Factions

-
Gain 100 Devotees or 100 Souls.

-
Gain 1,000 gold.

-
Spend 500 Devotees or 500 Souls to obtain one random ancillary.

-
Spend 10,000 Devotees or 10,000 Souls to obtain a major gift from Slaanesh.

Other Factions

-
+10% army replenishment for 1 turn.

-
Gain 1,000 gold.

-
Spend 3,000 gold to obtain one random ancillary.

-
Spend 25,000 gold to obtain a major gift from Slaanesh.

Supported Factions:

(Number in brackets indicates the current number of dilemmas available for that character)

-
Alarielle [4]

-
Elspeth [2]

-
Fay Enchantress [4]

-
Hellebron [1]

-
Katarin [4]

-
Miao Ying [4]

-
Morathi [4]

-
Repanse [4]

-
Sisters of Twilight [4]

Multi-Character Dilemmas:

-
Alarielle + Morathi [1]

-
Katarin + Miao Ying [1]

Additional info:

-
SOBORO is the real hero here for doing amazing Warhammer 3 artwork, here's their Fanbox site if anyone wants to throw some support their way: <https://so-boro.fanbox.cc/>

-
Dilemmas will trigger if the player confederates one of the female LL's, however this mod does not add a confederation feature.

-
I'd like to keep this mod focused in scope; dilemmas involving Slaanesh corrupting the world. I've found other mods that add features I originally wanted to include in mine:

-
No Confederation - All Factions <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2842459897> (To keep the target factions around/available) Not working as of 29 Dec 2024, crashes games.

-
Trade Any Settlement <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2931377022> (Trade vassal settlements easier/trade provinces that aren't connected)

Additional Feedback/suggestions are welcome! If anyone finds any bugs or has recommendations, feel free to leave a comment!
changelog_latest:
